phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: Manfred closed the owners meetings by saying owners will not compromise on a salary cap and floor, the union called that stance unserious, and a lockout after Dec. 1 is widely expected.
latest: Manfred said owners will not drop a cap and floor and he cannot see them ratifying a deal without one, though no lockout has been authorized and he offered to bargain through Thanksgiving. Union head Bruce Meyer said the plan would cut player pay and weaken guaranteed contracts.
